name: altium-mcp
description: Altium Designer integration server providing PCB and schematic design automation tools through MCP

tools.name: get_all_component_property_names
tools.description: Get all available component property names (JSON keys) from all components

tools.name: get_component_property_values
tools.description: Get values of a specific property for all components

tools.name: get_symbol_placement_rules
tools.description: Get schematic symbol placement rules from a local configuration file

tools.name: get_library_symbol_reference
tools.description: Get the currently open symbol from a schematic library to use as reference for creating a new symbol

tools.name: search_library_symbol
tools.description: Search for a symbol by name in a schematic library (.SchLib) and navigate to it. Supports partial name matching; opens the library file if a path is provided or shows a file picker if not

tools.name: create_schematic_symbol
tools.description: Create a new schematic symbol in the current library with the specified pins. Supports multi-part symbols via part_count and per-pin owner_part_id, plus active-low pin name overbar notation

tools.name: get_schematic_data
tools.description: Get schematic data for components in Altium

tools.name: get_pcb_layers
tools.description: Get detailed information about all layers in the current Altium PCB

tools.name: set_pcb_layer_visibility
tools.description: Set visibility for specified PCB layers

tools.name: get_component_data
tools.description: Get all data for components in Altium

tools.name: get_selected_components_coordinates
tools.description: Get coordinates and positioning information for selected components in Altium layout

tools.name: get_all_designators
tools.description: Get all component designators from the current Altium board

tools.name: get_component_pins
tools.description: Get pin data for components in Altium

tools.name: get_all_nets
tools.description: Return every unique net name in the active PCB document

tools.name: create_net_class
tools.description: Create a new net class and add specified nets to it

tools.name: set_component_position
tools.description: Set a component's absolute position (X, Y, rotation) in the PCB layout

tools.name: move_components
tools.description: Move selected components by specified X and Y offsets in the PCB layout

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the Altium window

tools.name: layout_duplicator
tools.description: First step of layout duplication. Selects source components and returns data to match with destination components

tools.name: layout_duplicator_apply
tools.description: Second step of layout duplication. Applies the layout of source components to destination components

tools.name: get_pcb_rules
tools.description: Get all design rules from the current Altium PCB

tools.name: get_pcb_layer_stackup
tools.description: Get the detailed layer stackup information from the current Altium PCB including copper thickness, dielectric materials, constants, and heights

tools.name: get_output_job_containers
tools.description: Get all available output job containers from a specified OutJob file

tools.name: run_output_jobs
tools.description: Run specified output job containers

tools.name: create_pcb_footprint
tools.description: Create a new PCB footprint in the currently active PcbLib document with SMD pads, auto-generated courtyard, and silkscreen with pin 1 indicator

tools.name: get_server_status
tools.description: Get the current status of the Altium MCP server
